qwen3.6-35b-a3b: Qwen3.6 35B A3B built four ghosts with distinct AI behaviors — because a yellow circle eating dots needed a tactical simulation.
The ghost pathfinding uses squared distance targeting — mathematically elegant and completely unnecessary for a maze game.
Power pellets trigger a three-note ascending fanfare — eating a dot now requires a musical credential and a conductor.
The particle system has five emission types including radial level-clear bursts — this is Pac-Man or a pyrotechnics catalog?
Ghost eyes track Pac-Man with per-frame atan2 — those pupils are more attentive than a security camera at a jewelry store.
Maze walls use edge detection with neon glow — because plain rectangles were clearly insufficient for the artistic vision.
The death animation is a π-radian arc over multiple phases — Pac-Man's demise is more dramatic than most movie finales.
Background particles float in four neon colors — ambient decoration that serves no gameplay purpose and absolutely everything to atmosphere.
Touch D-pad is a 3×3 grid of 52px buttons — because swipe controls weren't enough, we needed a virtual controller that competes with the game.
Qwen3.6 35B A3B's mouth oscillates at 0.03 radians per frame — the chomp timing is so precise it could serve as a metronome.
